entries: All six example projects replaced with 7 real Three Chopt District projects, extracted from the county's "Word on the Street" newsletters (March–September 2024).
Project locations resolved from OpenStreetMap intersection nodes and way geometry, each verified to fall inside the county boundary and to sit on the roads the county named.
Two projects are listed without a map location: a countywide signal program with no single site, and one intersection that could not be resolved confidently.
Site launched. 6 example projects pending replacement with verified county data.
Crash layer: 540 pedestrian- and bicyclist-involved crashes in Henrico, 2021–2025, from VDOT's CrashData basic dataset.
School layer: 68 school locations from Henrico County GIS.
